blocks.text: From the Zscaler Admin Console, you can configure notification settings for Zscaler Client Connector. Notification settings control which notifications display for end users in the app and how they display.

For Zscaler Client Connector for Windows and macOS, there are two types of notifications: the default OS-based notification system and Zscaler’s Notification Framework. Some notifications and related features require enabling the framework. To learn more, see Using the Zscaler Notification Framework.
Zscaler Client Connector Notification Settings provide the following benefits and allow you to:

blocks.item: Configure notification templates to enable or disable individual notifications or groups of notifications and assign the templates per app profile.

Customize the Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) users must accept before they can connect to the internet or access your organization's internal resources from devices protected by Zscaler Client Connector.
Configure a custom banner that displays IT support options for your organization to help users resolve issues.

blocks.heading: About the Client Connector Notification Page

blocks.text: On the Client Connector Notification page (Administration > End User Notification > Client Connector), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Configure a reminder notification to SecureAgent users.
View a list of notification templates. For each template you can view:
Name: The name of the template.
Show Zscaler Client Connector Notification Popups by Default: The value for the associated option on the Legacy tab in the template.

Legacy Template: Indicates if the template is the Legacy Notification Settings template that includes settings that previously controlled the enabling or disabling of groups of notifications tenant-wide. To learn more, see Configuring Notification Templates for Zscaler Client Connector.
Delete a notification template. You can't delete the Legacy Template.
